india_trends.title: Hexagon Nutrition IPO: Issue received healthy response on Day 01, booked 1.65 times; GMP signals solid listing

india_trends.title: GQG trims Adani exposure in Rs 5,750 crore block deal, sell shares in two group stocks
india_trends.summary: GQG Partners sold stakes in Adani Enterprises and Adani Energy Solutions worth about Rs 5,750 crore through block deals, with SBI Mutual Fund acquiring the shares. The transactions are seen as portfolio rebalancing after a strong recovery in Adani Group stocks over the past year.

india_trends.title: STT Global acquires 3.5-acre land parcel in Navi Mumbai for Rs 282 crore
india_trends.summary: STT Global Data Centres India has bought a 3.48-acre industrial property in Navi Mumbai's Mahape for Rs 282 crore. This strategic acquisition supports the growing demand for digital infrastructure. The site in the TTC Industrial Area offers access to power and connectivity.

india_trends.title: Sumitomo Corporation can invest ¥ 10 trillion in India over the next decade: S Jaishankar
